name: l2cap_stock_alloc

ownership.argument: This is the object a p67 caller builds for the send path. The payload starts at buf + 4 + *(u16 *)(buf + 2), leaving the four bytes at +4 free for the L2CAP header that the send handler writes.

provenance.source: Allocates payload_len + (header_len + 4) + 6 bytes with bt_alloc and zeroes them, then writes the two header words: u16 total length at +0 (= payload_len + header_len + 4) and u16 payload offset at +2 (= header_len + 4); when the payload offset exceeds 7 it also writes the header-type nibble 3 at +8. 114 call sites, all Bluelet buffer producers.
